verdicts.claim: What this showed is that, when the conditions are right, AI can go quite far.

verdicts.claim: It looks like an AI escape story, but what is really being tested is not only how smart the AI is, but also the skill of the people responsible for closing the doors.
verdicts.reason: 評価が運用担当者の「ドアを閉める技能」も試しているという、Ledgerにない評価目的を加えている。

verdicts.claim: The AI seemed to escape, but open doors and weak defenses played the bigger role.
verdicts.reason: 開放された環境や弱い防御がAIより「大きな役割」を果たしたという因果比較は、Ledgerに示されていない。
